meta.title: Public toilets
meta.note: Public toilets on the Isle of Man are run by several different bodies - local authorities, the Department of Infrastructure and private operators - and there is no single official list. This is compiled from published council and government information.
meta.incomplete: This list is not complete, particularly outside the towns. If you know of one that is missing or wrong, please use Feedback in the app.
meta.radarKeyNote: A RADAR key opens accessible toilets that are kept locked. On the Island they are available from Ramsey Town Hall and the Douglas Welcome Centre.
meta.changingPlacesNote: Changing Places toilets are a higher standard than a standard accessible toilet: a height-adjustable changing bench, a ceiling hoist and room for a carer. There are five on the Island.
